summary: License inventory is clean (100% permissive MIT/Apache/BSD, zero GPL/AGPL copyleft contamination). However, material legal risks exist: missing MaxMind GeoLite2 EULA attribution in UI, automated takedown risk from Indian bank trademarks in synthetic demo corpus, and trademark collision with sentry.io (Functional Software, Inc.). Business moat lies strictly in evidentiary verification rigor, with an honest niche SAM of $145k-$500k/yr in Indian higher-ed/CERT DFIR labs.

3.1_license_tree.npm_licenses: All standard permissive packages (React, Vite, Lucide, Tailwind, D3, MapLibre GL).
3.1_license_tree.verdict: Zero copyleft contamination. Suitable for MIT distribution or commercial appliance licensing.

maxmind_geolite2.finding: README acknowledges MaxMind, but MaxMind GeoLite2 EULA Section 3 requires explicit attribution on product documentation AND user interface with URL link (https://www.maxmind.com). UI currently has 0 MaxMind references.
maxmind_geolite2.remedy: Add MaxMind GeoLite2 attribution badge and link to UI footer and about modal.

abuse_ch.finding: URLhaus and ThreatFox feeds are integrated for local scoring. Permitted under research/CC-BY-SA terms; commercial bundling requires BYOK or API partner agreements.

virustotal.finding: VirusTotal Public API terms explicitly prohibit commercial packaging and multi-tenant redistribution. Commercial appliance must enforce BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) policy.

enron_ceas_nazario_provenance.finding: Git log and repo search confirm zero raw copyrighted training corpus bytes are committed in the repository. All training pipelines ingest separately.

bank_trademarks_in_demo_corpus.finding: sample_emails/ contains synthetic phishing lures using registered trademarks (State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Reserve Bank of India, Axis Bank). While README has a synthetic disclaimer, automated brand protection crawlers (MarkMonitor, PhishLabs) can flag the repo for hosting phishing materials.
bank_trademarks_in_demo_corpus.remedy: Sanitize synthetic domain/brand names to fictional entities (e.g. Apex National Bank, IndusTrust Bank).

trademark_conflict_sentry_io.finding: 'SENTRY' directly conflicts with sentry.io (Functional Software, Inc.), a globally registered trademark in IT/developer infrastructure.
trademark_conflict_sentry_io.remedy: Rename project to distinct brand (e.g. SENTRY-DFIR, VIGIL-EMAIL, SENTINEL-FORENSICS) before commercial incorporation or PyPI registration.
